# дэнчик (Denchik)

> Personal site of Denis Pushkaryov (дэнчик / Denchik), a backend developer based in Belgrade and author of the DenchikBricks LEGO channel. Short notes and longer articles about LEGO, retro tech, DIY electronics, and games. Bilingual: Russian at the root, English under /en/.

Full text of every page below is available in one file at [llms-full.txt](https://10on.github.io/about-me/llms-full.txt).

## Pages

- [Notes](https://10on.github.io/about-me/notes.html): short, frequent posts on any topic
- [Articles](https://10on.github.io/about-me/articles.html): longer written pieces
- [LEGO](https://10on.github.io/about-me/lego.html): collection (300+ sets), wishlist, project progress
- [Retro](https://10on.github.io/about-me/retro.html): retro computers and devices
- [DIY](https://10on.github.io/about-me/diy.html): electronics and 3D-printing projects
- [Games](https://10on.github.io/about-me/games.html): favorite video games and platforms
- [About](https://10on.github.io/about-me/about.html): bio and timeline

## English mirror

- [English home](https://10on.github.io/about-me/en/index.html): same site, translated pages under /en/
